title: Generative AI and Transformers
lead: Covers: discriminative vs generative AI, where transformers sit on the AI map, generation as repeated next-word prediction, why RNNs and LSTMs were not enough, an introductory background on tokens, embeddings, self-attention and the transformer block, and how a generative model is trained (unsupervised, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning). Note: your folder has no slides for this lesson, so the attention and transformer-block sections are clearly marked as background. No prior lecture attendance needed.
